e2436988989e.summary: Puerto Rico’s normally rainy season has instead brought a severe and fast-growing drought. The situation has become serious enough to trigger both local and federal disaster declarations.

685880194a52.title: The universe has plenty of hydrogen. So why is star formation collapsing?
685880194a52.summary: Star formation across the universe has fallen dramatically over the past 4.5 billion years, but astronomers have uncovered a surprising twist: the supply of neutral hydrogen, a key ingredient for making stars, has barely declined. • Slovenian wins stage 12 as Mas strengthens position

  • Tim Merlier claims stage two win at Tour of Britain

Spain’s Enric Mas extended his overall lead in the Vuelta a España with a late attack on his rivals as Slovenia’s Jakob Omrzel won stage 12 to Calar Alto on Thursday.

Movistar rider Mas burst out of a chasing group including red jersey contenders Primoz Roglic and Felix Gall with around ​13km of the mountainous 166.6km ride left and powered away.
